summary: One toggle in the Screenshots app stops the on-device model from reading and indexing every screenshot you take, and you can delete the summaries it already generated.

steps.path: Pixel Screenshots app → Settings → toggle off "Search your screenshots with on-device AI" → accept the offer to delete existing AI summaries and metadata
Nuclear option: Settings → Apps → Pixel Screenshots → Disable

collateral: screenshot search goes back to filenames and dates
whyTheyDidIt: Screenshots are a dense, personal corpus that makes on-device AI look magical in demos.

sources.label: Gadget Hacks — turn off AI processing in the Screenshots app
